huohuo_change_record.parity_coverage_notes: Regex-engine parity with ECMAScript (no `u` flag): (1) every `\s` uses the explicit JS whitespace class `_W` and every trim() uses `_js_trim` over the exact WhiteSpace+LineTerminator set (INCLUDES U+FEFF; EXCLUDES U+001C-U+001F and U+0085); (2) `\S{4,}` on the 因果 value is measured in UTF-16 code units via `_utf16_length` (surrogatepass), not code points; (3) every `/m` `^` is emulated with `_BOL` so it anchors after LF, CR, U+2028 and U+2029 like ECMAScript, not LF-only like Python `re.MULTILINE`; (4) the stripLengthAdjustInstructionEcho `< 360` check is a UTF-16 code-unit offset. Adversarial corpus vectors: ws_* (BOM/U+001C/NBSP), u16_* (astral 因果), lone_surrogate_*, header_after_* (CR/LS/PS). No residual divergence for the selected exports.

The corpus carries casefold_* adversarial vectors. No residual divergence for the selected exports.
